did: A read-only recon of every place home's server absorbs a failure into an ordinary value without counting it, after the mailbox's refused transcripts went unheard for eight days (server#1172). About 811 candidate lines across file_host and its crates were swept by pattern, then read by process. About 635 are benign, about 140 must be counted and four must be retried as well. They are filed as epic server#1174 with 17 defect children grouped so that each is one pull request, plus a proposal (server#1189) for a failure token that only a counting function can make, and a ratchet on silent Result erasure.

calls.title: An error-level log already counts as counted and alert-reachable
options: Treat error! as counted, because tracing_events_total feeds Grafana's Slack alert
Require a named per-process counter at every site
calls.why: Every error! event is already counted and alerted by target, so for most sites the smallest fix is raising the log level. A named counter is proposed only where the target alone would not say what failed.
calls.undo: Say so on server#1174 and each child gains a named counter instead.

calls.title: Existing issues folded in rather than duplicated
options: Attach server#809 (clips metrics) and server#864 (cards 404) as children
File new CONSERVE children for the same sites
calls.why: Both already describe the same absorbed failure with the same fix; the clips sites were added to server#809 in a comment.

left: Nothing was built: every child is open.
The some-ui ledger lacks processes for the Jobs arrival notice, the Snips pickup and the take-meaning embedder (OA1); raised to the coordinator, not filed in some-ui.
The counts are approximate: the readers' per-site tables were scratch files and are not kept; each child names its own sites.
